description: Quotes or starts one raw video clip in Create on the chosen video model (h3, h3-max, seedance, veo, kling4, or magi-2), optionally attaching reference pictures, videos or audio files (files: each { id, kind, use }). With run false nothing is spent and it returns the exact token price for that model, shape, length, quality and references. With run true, MAGI-2 (or a clip starting from an attached picture/video) films directly; otherwise image-to-video models draw the first frame first (pass clip_id with run true to film a drawn first frame). Spends tokens when run is true.

clip_id.description: Existing clip id whose first picture is already drawn: films it when run is true.

files.description: Optional reference files from create_catalog.references or create_ref_upload.

id.description: Reference file id from create_catalog.references or create_ref_upload.

kind.description: Type of reference file: picture, video or sound.

use.description: How the clip uses this reference file.

model.description: Video model: magi-2, h3, h3-max, seedance, veo, or kling4.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

run.description: true to spend tokens and start making the clip; false (default) only returns the exact quote.

say.description: Optional spoken line when an attached audio reference has use 'voice'.

seconds.description: Length in seconds: 5, 8, 10, 15, 20, or 30 (depends on model).

sentence.description: One clear description of what happens in the clip, camera movement, and sound.

name: clip_make
title: Make a video clip
